passage.label: Blessed He hand dominion over all competent; created death life test which best deed Exalted Might Forgiving; created seven heavens layers not see creation Most Merciful inconsistency return vision see breaks; return vision twice again return humbled fatigued; beautified nearest heaven stars made thrown at devils prepared punishment Blaze; disbelieved Lord punishment Hell wretched destination; thrown into it hear dreadful inhaling boils up; almost bursts rage every time company thrown keepers ask did not come warner; say yes warner came denied said Allah not sent down anything not but great error; say if only listening reasoning not among companions Blaze; admit sin alienation companions Blaze; fear Lord unseen forgiveness great reward; conceal speech publicize indeed Knowing within breasts; He who created not know Subtle Acquainted

arabicExcerpts.text: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ
ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ أَيُّكُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ عَمَلٗاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفُورُ
ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖ طِبَاقٗاۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلۡقِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٖۖ فَٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ هَلۡ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٖ
ثُمَّ ٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيۡنِ يَنقَلِبۡ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ خَاسِئٗا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٞ
وَلَقَدۡ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهَا رُجُومٗا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِۖ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لَهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
إِذَآ أُلۡقُواْ فِيهَا سَمِعُواْ لَهَا شَهِيقٗا وَهِيَ تَفُورُ
تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَيۡظِۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلۡقِيَ فِيهَا فَوۡجٞ سَأَلَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ نَذِيرٞ
قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ قَدۡ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٞ فَكَذَّبۡنَا وَقُلۡنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَيۡءٍ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ كَبِيرٖ
وَقَالُواْ لَوۡ كُنَّا نَسۡمَعُ أَوۡ نَعۡقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِيٓ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَأَجۡرٞ كَبِيرٞ
وَأَسِرُّواْ قَوۡلَكُمۡ أَوِ ٱجۡهَرُواْ بِهِۦٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
أَلَا يَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ

mainSubject.label: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, competent over all things; creator of death and life to test which is best in deed under might and forgiveness; seven layered heavens created without inconsistency in the Most Merciful's creation, challenged by returning vision twice until it returns humbled and fatigued; nearest heaven beautified with stars that also serve as missiles against devils with the Blaze prepared for them; disbelievers facing Hell's wretched destination where they hear its dreadful inhaling as it almost bursts with rage, its keepers asking whether a warner came, they admitting one did but they denied claiming nothing was sent down, acknowledging that had they listened or reasoned they would not be Blaze-companions, confessing their sin earning alienation; those fearing their Lord unseen promised forgiveness and great reward; speech concealed or publicised alike known to Him since the Creator is necessarily Subtle and Acquainted
